test_title: PYST 24 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

All planets are stars.

All stars are galaxies.

Conclusions:

I. All planets are galaxies.

II. All galaxies are planets.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe926a6aeb11ba1af42f4c00fecfe7806b6500a7ed78ada46e01b8103ba6b177.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c69fb8fa0b68f8500d25b94ac8df3d8f1b1c3aef89bde8b9ec9f6f951cc83ab.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All planets are galaxies → Follow (As all planets are stars and all stars are galaxies. As whole planets comes in stars which whole comes in galaxies, therefore it is true.)

(II) All galaxies are planets → Does not follow (As all planets are stars and all stars are galaxies. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
